assumptions: Bolted shunt faults at a single point; ABC phase rotation; RMS phasors.
LLG_BCG_common is B and C bonded to the same ideal ground point, not two remote earth faults.
Positive internal EMF is1.13pu for both modes. MAX/MIN differ only in online identical generators; G1 always online.
Generator R1 inferred from X1/(omega*Ta); generator R2=R1 is assumed, X2 is independently supplied.
Historical cable r0/x0 field names denote positive-sequence per-km impedance here; cable Z2=Z1 is assumed.
Transformer Z2=Z1. T2 grounded-star Z0=Z1 is a declared educational equivalent, not inferred from Dyn11 alone.
T2 zero equivalent includes its assumed zero neutral impedance; L3 R0=3R1 and X0=4X1 are explicit assumptions.
K1-K3 known_open is the ideal isolated, capacitance-free limit. The conditional LG zero is not a prediction of actual earth-fault current.
The supplied20A capacitive earth-fault network is outside this fixture. Unknown Z0 must not be substituted by known_open.
Every bus uses a local real positive EMF reference. Transformer group angle is not tested; compare phase magnitudes unless external common phase references are aligned.
No motor, passive prefault load, fault resistance, conductor-temperature correction, peak/DC transient, or open-phase case is included.
Nameplate calculation inputs are copied at original precision; no expected_results or computed impedance fields are used.
